DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来た道は濡れた葉が多いです。違う道で戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れ葉を避け帰路変更を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are lots of wet leaves on the path I took here. I'd like to return by another route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change your return route to avoid wet leaves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いるのは南の広場です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are now in the south plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ入口へ戻ります。自分で葉を掃いて道を作るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的入口と無断整備しない方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm returning to the same entrance. I don't intend to sweep the leaves myself to make a path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your destination entrance and that you won't alter the path without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you a paved route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し遠くてもそちらが希望です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遠い舗装道を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's what I'd prefer, even if it's a little farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the longer paved route in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can rest along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチのある所で一度止まりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中休憩を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to stop once somewhere with a bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a rest stop along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅側の入口はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The entrance on the station side is this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。落葉の道へ急いで戻らず、この道を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新経路で入口へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll use this route rather than hurry back to the path covered in leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll return to the entrance by the new route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 舗装道のベンチを経て駅側の入口へお進みください。通行状況の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Follow the paved path past the bench to the station-side entrance. Check the notices about current access as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your itinerary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遅れで最後の接続に間に合うか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最終接続の不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm worried the delay will make me miss the last connection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about the last connection in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 目的駅を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your destination station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅です。途中駅へ着くだけで帰宅できるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅先までの行程を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This station. I don't assume that reaching an intermediate station alone means I can get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the itinerary all the way home in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 接続の現状を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the current connection information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 接続がなければ、途中駅からの移動方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 接続不可時の代案を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there is no connection, I'd also like to ask how to travel onward from the intermediate station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for alternatives if you cannot make the connection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you ask someone to pick you up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に相談します。待つ駅をまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迎えの可否と場所未定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll discuss it with my family. We haven't decided which station they would wait at.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you'll ask about a pickup and that the location isn't decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内後に合流先を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can choose a meeting point after receiving the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 接続が保証されると伝えず、確認結果で家族へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 結果に基づいて連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't tell my family the connection is guaranteed. I'll contact them based on what you confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll contact them based on the confirmed result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の接続と代案を係員が説明します。行程を途中駅到着で完了とせず確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: A staff member will explain the current connections and alternatives. Check the whole itinerary rather than treating arrival at the intermediate station as the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。説明を忘れないよう録音できるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約前に録音可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Beforehand, I'd like to ask whether I can record it so I don't forget the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether recording is allowed before booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 許可前に録音せず、相談の予約だけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 許可前の録音をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't record without permission. Please just arrange the consultation booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't record before permission is granted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: What subject is the consultation about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住居です。自分の記録用で公開する希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用途と分野を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Housing. It's for my personal records, not because I want to publish it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the subject and purpose in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 録音できない場合もあります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その場合は、メモを取りながら説明を聞ける時間が欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不可時のメモ対応を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: In that case, I'd like enough time to take notes while listening to the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for time to take notes if recording isn't allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 希望時間帯を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: What time of day would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木曜午後です。録音の可否と予約確定を別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間候補と可否確定を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thursday afternoon. I'll check recording permission and confirmation of the booking separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State a proposed time and distinguish permission from booking confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 木曜午後の希望と記録方法を担当へ確認します。今は録音許可も予約も未確定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about Thursday afternoon and your recording method. Neither recording permission nor the booking is confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードの取消控えと、現金の領収書をもらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二種の会計控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a card-payment cancellation slip and a cash receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the two types of payment records in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの点を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚あるので二重払いか気になります。種類を分けて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二重払いを資料別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are two slips, so I'm concerned about paying twice. Please check them as different types of documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check for double payment using each document separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会計の記録を照合します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 診療まで取り消したという意味かも、自分では決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払取消と診療取消を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also can't determine for myself whether this means the medical consultation was cancelled too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish cancellation of payment from cancellation of the consultation in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払変更の記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the record of the change in payment method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は現金で払いました。提出用には何を使うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際の現金支払を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I paid cash today. I'd like to ask which document I should use for submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you actually paid cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出先の条件も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the requirements of the place you're submitting it to as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方を残して、支払の説明を聞いてから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両資料を保持して提出を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep both documents and submit them after hearing the explanation of the payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll retain both documents and check before submitting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 取消の対象と現金領収書を会計担当が確認します。診療の記録とは分けて案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The payment staff will check what was cancelled and the cash receipt. They will explain these separately from your medical records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a report?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の控えで、私の名前が一文字違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既届の氏名誤字を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On yesterday's copy, one character in my name is wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the typo in the name on your existing report in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the receipt number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。新しい紛失をもう一件届ける希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ届出番号を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I'm not asking to file another report for a new loss.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the number of the same report in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人の表記を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the correct spelling of your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資料はこちらです。落とした物と時刻は前の説明のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私物と時刻の不変を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are my documents. The lost item and the time remain as I explained before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the lost item and time have not changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先に変更はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。氏名の誤字だけを正しくしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先不変と訂正範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I only want to correct the typo in my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your contact information is unchanged and specify what needs correcting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 訂正の方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain how to make the correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを自分で直して済ませず、訂正後の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己訂正せず結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't just correct my copy myself and consider it done. I'll check the information after correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't simply correct it yourself and will check the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ届出番号の氏名訂正として確認します。控えと本人資料をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check this as a name correction under the same report number. Please bring the copy and your identification documents as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your redelivery request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明日の夕方を頼みましたが、急用で家にいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既申込後の不在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I requested tomorrow evening, but something urgent has come up and I won't be home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will be absent after already making a request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付結果を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the request confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。前の申込を残したまま二件目を作りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付結果で重複を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I won't create a second request while leaving the original one in place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the confirmation to avoid duplicate requests. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the conditions for changing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明後日の午前が候補です。家族の受取は頼んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 候補と代理未依頼を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The morning after tomorrow is an option. I haven't asked my family to receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the proposed time and that you haven't asked anyone to receive it for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の配達状態も調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also check the current delivery status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変更できなければ、受取方法を別に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不可時の別受取を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it can't be changed, I'd like to discuss a different way of receiving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about another way to receive it if a change isn't possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更後の結果を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the result after the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。元日時と新日時の状態を両方見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧新日時の結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll check the status of both the original and new date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll check the result for both old and new times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ荷物の既申込変更として案内します。重複依頼をせず、確定した日時をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll guide you through changing the existing request for the same parcel. Avoid duplicate requests and check the confirmed date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ銀行の物か確認したいです。店の名前がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 失くしたカード種別不明を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but I'd like to check whether it was a bank card. It had a shop's name on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the type of lost card is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残っている資料を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me any remaining documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この会員案内です。銀行のカードは家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会員案内と銀行カード所在を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the membership guide. My bank card is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the membership guide and state where the bank card is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行元を確認しましょう。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っている銀行カードまで、全部止める希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全カード停止の依頼でないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not asking to stop every card, including the bank card I still have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are not requesting suspension of all your cards.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店の会員窓口への連絡も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You also need to contact the shop's membership desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店に確認します。会員番号が決済番号かも未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行元と機能を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check with the shop. I haven't confirmed whether the membership number is also a payment number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the issuer and the card's functions in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回の対象を分けて相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish which card this consultation concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。失くしたカードの種類と、未確認の機能を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象限定で手続きを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll tell the person in charge the type of card I lost and which functions remain unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss procedures while limiting the request to the relevant card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象を特定する相談として承りました。発行元確認後に、必要な手続きを各窓口へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've understood this as a request to identify the relevant card. After confirming the issuer, consult the respective desks about the necessary procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a scratch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 保護シールを剥がすと傷が見えました。剥がす前は分かりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 剥離後の傷発見を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a scratch after peeling off the protective sticker. I couldn't tell before removing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you discovered the scratch after removing the sticker.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。剥がしたシールも残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用とシール保持を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I still have the sticker I removed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is unused and that you have kept the sticker.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a record of the purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分で磨いて消す前に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録を示し加工前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like you to look at it before I try polishing away the scratch myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the record and seek advice before altering the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発生時点は分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You don't know when the scratch occurred, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、初めからあったとは断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発生時点不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's right. I won't state definitely that it was there from the beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you don't know when it happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現物と付属品を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the item and its accessories.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。シールを貼り直して未開封とは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封と偽らず現物確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won't put the sticker back on and claim it is unopened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the item to be checked without falsely describing it as unopened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: シールを剥がした後の未使用品として確認します。記録とシールを担当へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check it as an unused item with the sticker removed. Please give the purchase record and sticker to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about somewhere to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベンチの周りに虫が集まっています。別の場所へ移りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 虫で休憩場所変更を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Insects are gathering around the bench. I'd like to move elsewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change your resting place because of insects.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらのベンチですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の横です。種類は分からないので蜂とは断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所と種類未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one beside the pond. I don't know the type of insect, so I won't say definitely that they're bees or wasps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the location and that the type of insect is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に位置を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the person in charge the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で巣を探したり枝を払ったりせず離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己対処せず離れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move away rather than search for a nest or brush branches aside myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll move away without handling it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 屋根の下のベンチをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can show you a bench under a roof.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこが希望です。食べ物と袋は持って移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を保持して移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd prefer that. I'll take my food and bag with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll move with your belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その先に出口もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is also an exit beyond it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少し休んだら帰ります。元のベンチには戻りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩後の出口を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go home after a short rest. I won't return to the original bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the exit after resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この道で屋根の下へどうぞ。池横の状態は担当へ報告しました。出口はその先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Follow this path to the covered area. I have reported the situation beside the pond. The exit is farther ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 休みが未確定です。買う前に変更と払戻の条件を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未確定日で購入条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My days off aren't confirmed. Before buying, I'd like to know the change and refund conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about purchase conditions when your date isn't confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 土曜か日曜です。同じ条件で両方使えるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 候補二日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Saturday or Sunday. I don't assume it can be used on either day under the same conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the two possible dates in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の種類で条件が変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Conditions vary with the ticket type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 安さだけで選ばず、変更手数料も比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 価格と変更費を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to choose only by price. I'd like to compare change fees too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the price and change fees in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕事の日はいつ分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When will you know your work schedule?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日です。候補の案内を持ち帰って考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確定時点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tomorrow. I'll take the information about the options home to consider it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese when the date will be confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は購入を保留しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you hold off on buying today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。日が決まってから便と有効日を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入保留して日付を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Once the day is decided, I'll check the service and valid travel date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll postpone buying and confirm the date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 候補二日の条件をご案内します。今日は発券せず、日付確定後にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain the conditions for both possible dates. We won't issue a ticket today; please return once the date is confirmed.
